description: DRAFT hand-authored furnace burn times in ticks (world.burn_time, §17.2) for the v0.1 fuels. Neither the data generator nor minecraft-data 3.117.0 carries burn times for 1.21.4 (vanilla builds them in code, FuelValues). Each entry is validated against the server's furnace lit-duration property by spike/experiments/e6-data.mjs. Tags expand against the data generator's item tags.
